description: Example sentences that define what a custom data type detects by meaning. In a draft only the anchors and the threshold are set; the other fields describe a version that has been activated.

ID.description: The identifier of the corpus in the analysis pipelines.
ID.title: ID

anchors.description: Reference phrases, one per entry, written the way a real person would type the content to detect. The evaluation shows how well they work.
anchors.title: anchors

embedderModel.description: The model the anchors were embedded with.
embedderModel.title: embedderModel

highThreshold.description: The similarity at or above which a detection is reported with high confidence, from the evaluation this version was activated with. Unset, none is.
highThreshold.title: highThreshold

mediumThreshold.description: The similarity at or above which a detection is reported with medium confidence, from the evaluation this version was activated with. Unset, none is.
mediumThreshold.title: mediumThreshold

recommendedThreshold.description: The threshold the evaluation recommended when this version was activated.
recommendedThreshold.title: recommendedThreshold

revision.description: The revision of the anchors. It changes only when the anchors do.
revision.title: revision

threshold.description: The similarity at or above which a message is detected. Unset, the analysis pipelines derive one from the anchors.
threshold.title: threshold

title: CustomDataTypeCorpus
